cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: A Kinder Version
cards.instruction: Protect someone from the full truth by offering a carefully edited explanation that feels kinder than complete honesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've decided you and I are having noodles. Nina's keeping her birthday dinner small.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She invited the whole choir. Can I see her message?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request for an explanation is approved. She's choosing people she sees regularly; it isn't a verdict on you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We rehearse every Tuesday. Read me the actual words.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm authorizing this much: she wants an uncomplicated evening. You may have one with me. I'll choose somewhere that doesn't require you to audition for a chair.
